part.name: Ergonomic housing with scroll-wheel pocket and wheel
part.description: Two-solid part: a main ergonomic shell/body (SOLID 0) with a rectangular wheel pocket/opening, plus a separate scroll wheel (SOLID 1) featuring toroidal outer grip surfaces and flat side faces. Overall form is a smooth freeform (BSPLINE) housing with distinct left/right side skins and an underside/base skin.
part.symmetry_note: Overall body is near bilaterally symmetric left-right, but freeform surfaces suggest mild ergonomic asymmetry; wheel/pocket is centered approximately in width.

Section.name: Upper ergonomic shell
features included: Wheel opening boundary (cutout edge on top skin, implied by inner wire on top face)
Rear/top crown transition into side skins
Section.function intent: Provide the main exterior cover/hand-contact surface and define the top aperture boundary for the wheel pocket.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a thin shell distributing local hand/applied loads into the side and base skins; curvature increases stiffness and reduces local deflection around the wheel opening.
Section.geometry: Large BSPLINE top skin with an internal loop (opening) plus a secondary rear/top BSPLINE patch transitioning to the tail region.
Section.location: Top of the main body, spanning most of length and width; includes the rear top crown.

major_faces.name: Rear top crown patch
major_faces.description: BSPLINE exterior patch near the rear/top region; gently curved crown area.

major_faces.name: Main top shell with wheel cutout
major_faces.description: Large BSPLINE exterior top surface; includes an inner wire representing the wheel opening boundary.

Section.name: Underside / base skin
Section.function intent: Provide the bottom envelope and stable support interface to an external surface; close the shell volume structurally.
Section.physical behavior: Works as the lower shell of a closed section, increasing bending/torsional stiffness; freeform underside transitions reduce stress concentrations at nose/tail.
Section.geometry: Two BSPLINE patches: a long near-planar underside band and a front underside transition patch.
Section.location: Bottom of the main body, spanning most of length; includes the front underside/nose region.

major_faces.name: Front underside transition
major_faces.description: BSPLINE patch forming the nose/front underside curvature from base to sides.

major_faces.name: Main underside base band
major_faces.description: Long BSPLINE underside surface near minimum Y; primary bottom skin.

Section.name: Left side skin
Section.function intent: Provide lateral enclosure, ergonomic side support, and load path between top and base skins.
Section.physical behavior: Operates as a vertical/oblique shell web carrying shear between top and bottom skins; curvature provides buckling resistance.
Section.geometry: Single BSPLINE side surface forming the left flank.
Section.location: Left side of main body (near minimum X of bbox).

major_faces.name: Left flank surface
major_faces.description: BSPLINE exterior surface along left side, blending between top and underside.

Section.name: Right side skin
Section.function intent: Provide lateral enclosure and a structural web between top and base skins on the right side.
Section.physical behavior: Carries shear and stabilizes the shell; freeform curvature increases stiffness and improves ergonomic contour.
Section.geometry: Single BSPLINE side surface forming the right flank.
Section.location: Right side of main body (near maximum X of bbox).

major_faces.name: Right flank surface
major_faces.description: BSPLINE exterior surface along right side, blending between top and underside.

Section.name: Wheel pocket / opening walls (in main body)
Section.function intent: Create a controlled opening and internal clearance volume for the wheel, constraining its lateral position and providing a defined aperture through the top shell.
Section.physical behavior: Planar walls act as hard stops/clearance boundaries; local pocket geometry stiffens the opening perimeter and defines assembly space for wheel/axle components (not modeled).
Section.geometry: Set of planar faces forming a rectangular pocket: opposing side walls, a floor, a roof/ledge, and an end wall.
Section.location: Near the top mid-region around the wheel opening (near x≈25–31, y≈10–28, z≈44–59).

major_faces.name: Pocket floor
major_faces.description: Planar face forming the bottom of the wheel pocket volume (normal ~ +Z).

major_faces.name: Pocket left wall
major_faces.description: Planar side wall of pocket on one lateral side (normal ~ +X with slight tilt).

major_faces.name: Pocket roof/ledge
major_faces.description: Planar face forming the top internal boundary/ledge of the pocket (normal ~ -Z).

major_faces.name: Pocket right wall
major_faces.description: Planar side wall of pocket on the opposing lateral side (normal ~ -X with slight tilt).

major_faces.name: Pocket end wall
major_faces.description: Planar end wall closing one side of the pocket (normal ~ +Y).

Section.name: Scroll wheel (separate solid)
features included: Flat side faces for axle/hub interfaces (modeled as planar caps)
Wheel outer profile sized to pass through top opening
Section.function intent: Provide a rolling interface for user input; mate to an axle/hub (not modeled) and rotate within the pocket/opening.
Section.physical behavior: Rigid small solid rotating about its axis; toroidal exterior provides finger traction and a smooth rolling contact; flat side faces provide assembly datum surfaces for an axle or bracket.
Section.geometry: Two TORUS faces forming the outer rolling band, plus two planar side faces acting as lateral caps/flats.
Section.location: Centered within/above the pocket opening in the top region (SOLID 1 bbox x≈25.4–30.4, y≈15.1–29.1, z≈44.2–58.3).

major_faces.name: Left wheel side flat
major_faces.description: Planar side face on one side of the wheel (axle/bracket interface).

major_faces.name: Outer torus band A
major_faces.description: TORUS patch forming part of the wheel outer rolling surface.

major_faces.name: Right wheel side flat
major_faces.description: Planar side face on the opposite side of the wheel (axle/bracket interface).

major_faces.name: Outer torus band B
major_faces.description: TORUS patch forming the remaining part of the wheel outer rolling surface.
